issues.detail: Perspective bridged drawings were inspected, but C1 in 5 and C1/C4 in 21/6 are left unassigned rather than guessing. These records are not complete stereochemical training targets until independently resolved.
SI S24 separates (-)-6 (4.28 mg) and (+)-6 (4.37 mg) from 10 mg racemate; no absolute graph assignment is inferred solely from signs or HPLC retention.
SI S10 prose calls product 16; heading/scheme/formula identify acetate 17. SI S11 calls cycloaddition feed 8 but mass and scheme identify 17.
Main Scheme 7 gives H2SO4/EtOH/60 C; SI S17 actual experiment gives HCl/MeOH/80 C. Both locators retained; SI conditions are used.
